unitTitle: The Shark Caller - Episode 1: The Curse
scanNote:
1-HIKOYA, 1-QISM (24-bet). KOMIKS shaklidagi bet.

Yuqorida chapda TO'Q KO'K yorliqda oq harflar: 'Episode 1' (yonida kassetа belgisi) va ostida 'The Curse'.
O'ng tomonda katta TO'Q SARIQ bo'rtma harflar bilan: 'The Shark Caller'.

Ostida kirish matni: 'Mike, the editor of The Morning Sun, has sent Sandra and David to the village of Kontu in the South Pacific. They are going to investigate the story of a man, Senan, who has the power to call sharks.'

SAKKIZTA RASMLI KADR (chizma), har birida gap pufakchalari:

1-KADR: Palma va somon tomli kulbalar orasida sariq sochli ayol (Sandra) va qora sochli erkak (David) turibdi; orqada ikki mahalliy erkak. Pufakchalar: 'So, this is the village of Kontu. Let's find Senan now.' va 'Look at those two men. Senan must be the one on the left.'

2-KADR: Sandra va David; o'ngdan qora tanli erkak yaqinlashmoqda. Pufakchalar: "No, it can't be him. He's too young. Senan must be the older man. Look, he's coming over." va "His eyes look like a shark's, and he's got marks on his arms and legs."

3-KADR: Qora tanli erkakning (Senan) yaqin surati; bo'ynida akula tishlaridan marjon. Pufakcha: 'Hello, Sandra. Hello, David. Come. My hut is this way.'

4-KADR: Kulba ichida uchovlon o'tiribdi, oldilarida idishda ovqat. Pufakchalar: 'How do you know who we are?' va 'I dreamt about you. Now you must prepare for tomorrow. You must eat only sweet potatoes and go to sleep early tonight.'

5-KADR: Yana kulba ichida. Pufakchalar: 'But what is all this for?' va "Don't ask questions. Do as I say. I'm going to the forest to begin my magic and dream of the shark."

6-KADR: Tunda o'rmonda gulxan yonida Senan qo'llarini ko'tarib turibdi. Pufakcha: 'Heeya, Heeya ...'

7-KADR: Kulrang qutida yozuv 'NEXT MORNING ON THE SHORE'. Qirg'oqda suvda turgan erkak qo'llarini ko'tarib qichqirmoqda. Pufakcha: 'I curse you, Senan! I command the skies to bring rain!'

8-KADR: Dengizda qayiqdagi uch kishi; qirg'oqda haligi erkak turibdi. Pufakchalar: 'Who's that man? He looked very angry!' va "He's Mosan. He's jealous of me. Now, get ready. The shark is near us."

9-KADR: Qayiqda Senan suvni kokos qobig'i bilan urmoqda; Sandra va David qaramoqda. Pufakchalar: "Sandra, look! He's beating the water with coconut shells." va "It is magic. It worked! There are shark fins over there ... Oh, no! A shark is under the canoe! It'll attack us! David, do something!"

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '24'.

sections.title: The Shark Caller - Episode 1: The Curse

exercises.instructionEn: The Shark Caller - Episode 1: The Curse
exercises.explanationUz:
KOMIKS - HIKOYaNING BIRINChI QISMI.

  ⚠ Kitobda uchta hikoya bor, har biri
  ikki qismdan (uchinchisidan tashqari).
  Ular har uch-to'rt unitdan keyin
  keladi.

  ⚠ Hikoya - DAM OLISh emas: har biri
  bitta grammatika mavzusini
  mustahkamlaydi. Bu qismning mavzusi:
  ANIQLIK bildirish (must, can't, will).


QAHRAMONLAR:

  Mike   - 'The Morning Sun' gazetasining
           MUHARRIRI
  Sandra - muxbir (sariq sochli)
  David  - muxbir (qora sochli)
  Senan  - 'akula chaqiruvchi'
  Mosan  - Senanning raqibi


JOY: Kontu qishlog'i, Janubiy Tinch
okeani.


⚠ 'THE SHARK CALLER':

  = akula chaqiruvchi.
  ⚠ 'to call' (chaqirmoq) → 'a caller'.

  ⚠ Bu - HAQIQIY an'ana: Papua Yangi
  Gvineyaning ba'zi qishloqlarida
  akula chaqiruvchilar bo'lgan.


⚠ 'A CURSE':

  = la'nat.
  ⚠ 'to curse sb' = kimnidir la'natlamoq.
  ⚠ Mosan 7-kadrda aynan shuni qiladi:
  'I CURSE you, Senan!'


⚠ MATNDAGI 'MUST' VA 'CAN'T':

  'Senan MUST be the one on the left.'
     = chap tomondagi Senan bo'lsa kerak
  "No, it CAN'T be him."
     = yo'q, u bo'lishi mumkin emas
  'Senan MUST be the older man.'
     = Senan kattaroq odam bo'lsa kerak

  ⚠ Bu yerda 'must' MAJBURIYaT EMAS,
  TAXMIN bildiradi (25-betdagi quti).


⚠ 'YOU MUST PREPARE' - BOShQA MA'NO:

  'Now you MUST prepare for tomorrow.'
  ⚠ Bu esa HAQIQIY MAJBURIYaT.

  ⚠ Ya'ni bitta hikoyada 'must' ning
  IKKI ma'nosi ham bor - ataylab.


⚠ "IT'LL ATTACK US":

  = u bizga hujum qiladi.
  ⚠ "it'll" = 'it will' - KELAJAK haqida
  taxmin (25-betdagi 'Will' qutisi).

points.en: Mike, the editor of The Morning Sun, has sent Sandra and David to the village of Kontu in the South Pacific.
points.uz: 'The Morning Sun' gazetasining muharriri Mayk Sandra va Devidni Janubiy Tinch okeanidagi Kontu qishlog'iga jo'natdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'an editor' = muharrir.
⚠ 'has sent' - PRESENT PERFECT: yubordi va
ular hozir o'sha yerda.
⚠ 'the South Pacific' - 'the' bilan.

points.en: They are going to investigate the story of a man, Senan, who has the power to call sharks.
points.uz: Ular akulalarni chaqirish qudratiga ega Senan ismli odamning hikoyasini o'rganmoqchi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'be going to' = niyat (5-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'to investigate' = tekshirmoq, o'rganmoq.
⚠ 'the power TO DO sth' - otdan keyin INFINITIV.

points.en: So, this is the village of Kontu. Let's find Senan now.
points.uz: Xo'sh, bu Kontu qishlog'i. Endi Senanni topaylik.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "Let's" = 'let us' - taklif.
⚠ Keyin ODDIY fe'l: "Let's FIND" ('to find' EMAS).

points.en: Look at those two men. Senan must be the one on the left.
points.uz: Anavi ikki erkakka qarang. Senan chap tomondagisi bo'lsa kerak.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'must' bu yerda TAXMIN: 'bo'lsa kerak'.
⚠ 'the one' = o'sha kishi (takrorlamaslik uchun).
⚠ 'ON the left' - predlog 'on'.

points.en: No, it can't be him. He's too young. Senan must be the older man. Look, he's coming over.
points.uz: Yo'q, u bo'lishi mumkin emas. U juda yosh. Senan kattaroq odam bo'lsa kerak. Qara, u bu yoqqa kelyapti.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "can't be" - TAXMINNING INKORI:
'bo'lishi mumkin emas'.
⚠ 'too young' = juda yosh (haddan tashqari).
⚠ 'to come over' = yaqinlashmoq.

points.en: His eyes look like a shark's, and he's got marks on his arms and legs.
points.uz: Uning ko'zlari akulanikiga o'xshaydi va qo'l-oyog'ida belgilar bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "a shark's" = "a shark's eyes" - takroriy ot
TUShIRIB QOLDIRILGAN.
⚠ 'to look like' = ... ga o'xshamoq.
⚠ 'a mark' = belgi, iz.

points.en: Hello, Sandra. Hello, David. Come. My hut is this way.
points.uz: Salom, Sandra. Salom, Devid. Yuringlar. Kulbam bu tomonda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a hut' = kulba (5-mashqda ham bor).
⚠ 'this way' = bu tomonda, bu yoqda.

points.en: How do you know who we are?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'who we are' - O'ZLAShTIRMA SO'ROQ:
so'z tartibi ODDIY GAPDAGIDEK ('who are we' EMAS).
⚠ Bu 14-unitning grammatika mavzusi.

points.en: I dreamt about you. Now you must prepare for tomorrow. You must eat only sweet potatoes and go to sleep early tonight.
points.uz: Men sizlarni tush ko'rdim. Endi ertangi kunga tayyorgarlik ko'rishing kerak. Faqat shirin kartoshka yeb, bugun erta uxlashing kerak.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'dreamt' - Britaniya shakli ('dreamed' - AQSh).
⚠ 'to dream ABOUT sb' - predlog 'about'.
⚠ Bu yerda 'must' HAQIQIY MAJBURIYaT - oldingi
'must' lardan FARQ QILADI.

points.en: But what is all this for?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'What ... FOR?' = nima uchun?
⚠ 'for' HAR DOIM oxirida qoladi.
⚠ 'Why?' bilan bir xil ma'no, lekin
so'zlashuvda ko'proq ishlatiladi.

points.en: Don't ask questions. Do as I say. I'm going to the forest to begin my magic and dream of the shark.
points.uz: Savol bermang. Men aytganday qiling. Men o'rmonga sehrimni boshlash va akulani tush ko'rish uchun ketyapman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to ASK questions' - 'to do' EMAS.
⚠ 'Do as I say' = men aytganday qiling.
⚠ 'to dream OF' - 'about' bilan ham bo'ladi.

⚠ Bu - so'z emas, SEHRLI qichqiriq.
⚠ Komikslarda tovushni yozish uchun bunday
shakl ishlatiladi.

points.en: NEXT MORNING ON THE SHORE - I curse you, Senan! I command the skies to bring rain!
points.uz: ERTASI KUNI ERTALAB QIRG'OQDA - Seni la'natlayman, Senan! Osmonga yomg'ir yog'dirishni buyuraman!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a shore' = qirg'oq (dengiz).
⚠ 'to curse' = la'natlamoq - QISM NOMI shu
so'zdan.
⚠ 'to command sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'the skies' - she'riy shakl ('the sky' o'rniga).

points.en: Who's that man? He looked very angry!
points.uz: Anavi odam kim? U juda jahli chiqqanga o'xshardi!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to look angry' = jahli chiqqanga o'xshamoq
(5-mashqda ham bor).
⚠ 'looked' - PAST SIMPLE.

points.en: He's Mosan. He's jealous of me. Now, get ready. The shark is near us.
points.uz: U Mosan. U menga hasad qiladi. Endi tayyorlaning. Akula yaqinimizda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'jealous OF sb' - predlog 'of'
(8-betdagi 14-mashqda ham bor edi).
⚠ 'to get ready' = tayyorlanmoq (5-mashqda).
⚠ 'near' - predlogsiz: 'near us'.

points.en: Sandra, look! He's beating the water with coconut shells.
points.uz: Sandra, qara! U suvni kokos qobiqlari bilan urmoqda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to beat' = urmoq (beat - beat - beaten).
⚠ 'a shell' = qobiq.
⚠ 'WITH' - qurol/vosita predlogi.

points.en: It is magic. It worked! There are shark fins over there ... Oh, no! A shark is under the canoe! It'll attack us! David, do something!
points.uz: Bu sehr. Ishladi! Anavi yerda akula qanotlari ko'rinyapti ... Voy! Qayiq ostida akula bor! U bizga hujum qiladi! Devid, biror narsa qil!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'It IS magic' - 'is' TA'KIDLANGAN
(qiya harfda berilgan).
⚠ 'a fin' = suzgich, qanot (baliqniki).
⚠ "it'll attack" = 'it will' - KELAJAK haqida
taxmin (25-betdagi 'Will' qutisi).
⚠ 'a canoe' = qayiq; /kəˈnuː/ deb o'qiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: Senan must be the older man.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'must' bu yerda TAXMIN: 'bo'lsa kerak'.
⚠ Keyin ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q).

patterns.exampleEn: No, it can't be him. He's too young.
patterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, u bo'lishi mumkin emas. U juda yosh.

patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "Let's" = 'let us' - taklif.
⚠ Keyin ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q).

patterns.exampleEn: You must eat only sweet potatoes and go to sleep early.
patterns.exampleUz: Faqat shirin kartoshka yeb, erta uxlashing kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bu yerda 'must' - HAQIQIY MAJBURIYaT.
⚠ Bir hikoyada 'must' ning IKKI ma'nosi ham bor.

⚠ "it'll" = 'it will' - kelajak haqida TAXMIN.
⚠ 25-betdagi 'Will' qutisining mavzusi.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ OT VA FE'L BIR XIL ShAKLDA
groups.explanationUz: Hikoyada bir necha so'z ham OT, ham FE'L bo'lib keladi.
